Track-shape heterogeneity per IZ

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity.R
summarize_track_shape.Rd

For IZs with at least min_active_cells tracks, the binary coverage profile of each track around the IZ centre is compared with its progress-expected profile (correct_signal_matrix()): mean correlation (mean_track_similarity; 1 - RMSE where undefined), residual variance and the residual error after a rank-pca_rank SVD.

Usage

summarize_track_shape(
  track_intervals,
  iz_metadata,
  method = c("spline", "bin"),
  n_progress_bins = 10L,
  spline_df = 4L,
  window_bp = 500000L,
  bin_size = 20000L,
  min_active_cells = 5L,
  pca_rank = 2L,
  compute_pca = TRUE,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

track_intervals, iz_metadata

From prepare_iz_data().

method, n_progress_bins, spline_df

Correction settings.

window_bp, bin_size

Profile window half-width and step (bp).

min_active_cells

Minimum number of tracks.

pca_rank, compute_pca

SVD settings.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam used over IZs.

Value

A data.frame, one row per IZ.
